Subscription.Description: App Control for Business (WDAC) and Code Integrity policy audit and block events. Targets: Windows 10+
Subscription.Query: <QueryList> <Query Id="0" Path="Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational"> <!-- 3076 audit-mode would-block, 3077 enforced block, 3033/3034 signing level not met (block/audit) --> <Select Path="Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational">*[System[Provider[@Name='Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity'] and (EventID=3033 or EventID=3034 or EventID=3076 or EventID=3077)]]</Select> </Query> </QueryList>
